entries.ex: Aunque llueve, salgo.
entries.exEn: Although it's raining, I'm going out.

entries.ex: Es caro; sin embargo, me gusta.
entries.exEn: It's expensive; however, I like it.

entries.ex: Salimos a pesar de la lluvia.
entries.exEn: We went out despite the rain.

entries.ex: Fui a pesar de que estaba enfermo.
entries.exEn: I went even though I was ill.

entries.ex: Él come carne; yo, en cambio, no.
entries.exEn: He eats meat; I, on the other hand, don't.

entries.ex: Leo mientras como.
entries.exEn: I read while I eat.

entries.ex: Yo trabajo, mientras que tú descansas.
entries.exEn: I work, whereas you rest.

entries.ex: Ya que estás aquí, ayúdame.
entries.exEn: Since you're here, help me.

entries.ex: Como no tengo coche, voy en tren.
entries.exEn: As I don't have a car, I go by train.

entries.ex: No voy porque estoy cansado.
entries.exEn: I'm not going because I'm tired.

entries.ex: Estoy cansado; por eso no voy.
entries.exEn: I'm tired; that's why I'm not going.

entries.ex: Llueve, así que me quedo en casa.
entries.exEn: It's raining, so I'm staying at home.

entries.ex: No hay trenes; por lo tanto, voy en coche.
entries.exEn: There are no trains; therefore, I'm going by car.

entries.ex: Es barato y, además, es bonito.
entries.exEn: It's cheap and, on top of that, it's pretty.

entries.ex: Vino todo el mundo, incluso mi jefe.
entries.exEn: Everyone came, even my boss.

entries.ex: Por un lado, me gusta la idea.
entries.exEn: On the one hand, I like the idea.

entries.ex: Por otro lado, es muy caro.
entries.exEn: On the other hand, it's very expensive.

entries.ex: En primer lugar, muchas gracias.
entries.exEn: Firstly, thank you very much.

entries.ex: Al final no fuimos.
entries.exEn: In the end we didn't go.

entries.ex: De hecho, ya lo sabía.
entries.exEn: In fact, I already knew.

entries.ex: Llego el lunes, es decir, mañana.
entries.exEn: I arrive on Monday, that is to say, tomorrow.

entries.ex: No tengo dinero, o sea, no voy.
entries.exEn: I have no money, in other words, I'm not going.

entries.ex: Por cierto, ¿cómo está tu madre?
entries.exEn: By the way, how's your mother?

entries.ex: Me gusta el sur, por ejemplo, Cádiz.
entries.exEn: I like the south, for example, Cádiz.

entries.ex: Me gusta el pescado, sobre todo el atún.
entries.exEn: I like fish, above all tuna.

entries.ex: Primero comemos y luego salimos.
entries.exEn: First we eat and then we go out.

entries.ex: Comemos y luego salimos.
entries.exEn: We eat and then we go out.

entries.ex: De repente, empezó a llover.
entries.exEn: Suddenly, it started to rain.

entries.ex: En realidad, no tengo hambre.
entries.exEn: Actually, I'm not hungry.

entries.ex: En general, estoy contento.
entries.exEn: In general, I'm happy.
